analysis_md:
解答 由极坐标方程可得参数方程

$$\begin{cases}x=a(1+\theta)\cos\theta\\y=a(1+\theta)\sin\theta\end{cases}$$

两边同时对 $\theta$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{d\theta}=a\cos\theta-a(1+\theta)\sin\theta，\quad\frac{dy}{d\theta}=a\sin\theta+a(1+\theta)\cos\theta，$$

可得 $\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/d\theta}{dx/d\theta}=\frac{a((1+\theta)\cos\theta+\sin\theta)}{a(\cos\theta-(1+\theta)\sin\theta)}=\frac{1+\theta+\tan\theta}{1-(1+\theta)\tan\theta}$
